result.summary: Found 1 issue: duplicate content in the "Fastest near you" carousel where the same restaurant card appears twice.

issues.description: The "Fastest near you" section displays two identical "Green Bowl Poké" cards with the same image, delivery time (15-25 min), and delivery fee (€0.90), suggesting a data duplication or carousel rendering bug.
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicate entry or ensure unique restaurant results are displayed in the carousel.
